title: Internal: Debit Card Replacement Options by Account Tier
summary: Explains debit card replacement limits, shipping fees, rush/expedited options, and card design fees by checking account tier (ENTRY, MID, PREMIUM, ELITE). Includes the 48-hour post-closure wait (ENTRY only), tier replacement caps per rolling 12 months, excess replacement fees ($25/$15), and how to count replacement history using issue_reason and date_issued.
faqs: What are my debit card replacement limits per rolling 12-month period for my account tier?
How long do I have to wait after my card closure before I can order a replacement (by tier)?
What shipping options and delivery fees apply for ENTRY, MID, PREMIUM, and ELITE replacements?
If I already reached my replacement limit, can I pay an excess replacement fee instead of waiting? What are the amounts by tier?
How much are the card design fees (CLASSIC, PREMIUM/metallic silver, CUSTOM/uploaded image) for my tier?
How do you determine whether my prior replacement cards count toward the limit? Which issue_reason values are excluded?
keywords: 48-hour waiting period after card closure (ENTRY only)
